description: Illumina NovaSeq 6000 sequencing: GSM8113658: ChIP-seq-Ser2P-DLD1-shScr-HS-Rep2 Homo sapiens ChIP-Seq
library_construction_protocol: For RNA: RNA from HCT116 cells was isolated using the RNeasy mini kit (Qiagen, #74106) as per manufacturer's instructions. For ChIP: Immunoprecipitated DNA was purified using a ChIP DNA Clean&Concentrator kit (Zymo Research, D5205). Cells were crosslinked with 1% formaldehyde (Thermo Scientific, Cat# 28908) in PBS for 10 min at r.t. To shear chromatin, sonication was performed using the E220 ultrasonicator (Covaris). The mouse embryonic fibroblast spike-in chromatin was added to the sample chromatin. Immunoprecipitation was performed using anti-Ser2P Pol II CTD (Active motif, Cat# 61083) and Dynabeads Protein G (ThermoFisher, Cat# 10004D) at 4°C. Protein degradation using proteinase K (Roche, Cat# 3115828001) and reverse crosslinking were performed at 65°C overnight. The immunoprecipitated DNA was purified using QIAquick PCR Purification Kit (Qiagen, Cat# 28106). ChIP libraries were prepared using the KAPA HTP library preparation kit (KAPA Biosystems). RNA-seq libraries were prepared using the NEBNext® Ultra™ II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina® (New England Biolabs, # E7760L).
